I've been a Proton Unlimited subscriber... Proton Pass is my default for all 2FA. I love the browser extension, so easy and sleek.

There's still nothing about the telemetry in the browser extension?... telemetry data is anonymous, but it's always sent to the remote endpoint, and the only way to disable it is from your Proton account, not the extension itself.

Pity it's only available on iOS and Android as apps and as browser extensions elsewhere. I would've been interested to check out a desktop password manager that's free/cheap and is not based on Electron.
